newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan key 3-mth CD rate rises to 0.64 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan key 3-mth CD rate rises to 0.64 pct.

text.p: Key three-month certificates of deposit (CD) were issued at 0.64 percent on Thursday afternoon, the highest rate since August 9, 1996, traders said.
The issued volume was around 100 billion yen.

The rate has been moving upwards due to expectations of higher Japanese interest rates since the Bank of Japan announced stronger-than-expected results of its "tankan" survey of corporate sentiment on Wednesday, traders said.
Earlier in the morning, 20 billion yen of three-month CDs were issued at 0.63 percent, a rate unchanged from Wednesday's issued rate.
